# Robust dense Clifford recovery from a low mixed-nullity source

This constructs the missing robust acquisition step using actual copies of a fixed forward source, not a supplied stabilizer list, conditional state oracle, or controlled encoding inverse. Bell sampling and symplectic compilation are ordinary primitives. The distinctive link is a positive coset-projection inequality which handles GLOBAL coherent source errors without inferring a convex clean component.

The initial fixed-reference-label construction is A's. Root independently reconstructed that link and supplied the adaptive hyperplane refinement in Section 5, removing its exponential dependence on the number of logical qubits. C supplies the reusable public signed-Pauli compiler. Their source files and execution scope are kept separate from this derivation.

## 1. Source, promise and native operations

Let q logical qubits be encoded in n physical qubits. Write k=2^q and m=n+q. The ideal source has the form

`N0(w)=U0[w tensor |0><0|^(n-q-t) tensor sigma_t]U0^*`,       (1)

where U0 is an UNKNOWN physical Clifford and sigma_t is an arbitrary UNKNOWN mixed t-qubit state. The pure ancillas may themselves be in an unknown stabilizer frame, which can be absorbed into U0. The t-qubit state may have arbitrary rank, magic, degeneracy and conditioning. There is no local-support/weight promise on U0 or its logical Pauli images.

The actual source N is fixed memoryless CPTP, with normalized channel Choi states rho and rho0. The structural completeness hypothesis is

`Dtr(rho,rho0)=(1/2)||rho-rho0||_1<=eta`.                    (2)

It is a GLOBAL trace-distance hypothesis, not constant error per site, gate or output qubit. It is not inferred from an unverified device fidelity. In particular a nearby unitary channel need not have any nonzero convex identity component; that stronger and generally false inference is NOT used.

Four such Choi programmes allow two transversal Bell measurements; XOR their phase-free Pauli labels to obtain a Bell DIFFERENCE label in F2^(2m). There are four forward calls per candidate. state. Its normalized Choi state J0 has m=n+q qubits. Fix its evident SIGNED

pure-junk generators. Its binary rank is m-t; reference-label projection
pi:S->{0,1}^{2q} is onto. Extra stabilizers of sigma_t are unnecessary.

The actual unknown source N is memoryless CPTP. Each forward Bell-input use
supplies one independent J=J(N). Assume the GIVEN warranted structural bounds
above and D_tr(J,J0)<=eta. The Clifford, sigma, stabilizers and any projections
below are NOT supplied operationally. Actual coherent errors are allowed.
Choose0<tau<=1/8 and eta<=tau/8. Forward inverse/dilation control is absent.

# Strong ordinary mixed compression already supplies the qualitative decoder

30 October 2026. This is A's primary-source reconstruction and matched-route
derivation. It retires a claim of a newly enabled generic robust low-nullity
decoder. It does not retire the explicit direct acquisition upper bound in
COHERENT_COSET_PROOF.md. No source, tomography, or quantum circuit was run here.

## 1. The actual primary supplier and its definition ambiguity

The controlling source is Chen--Gong--Ye--Zhang, *Stabilizer bootstrapping:
A recipe for efficient agnostic tomography and magic estimation*,
arXiv2408.06967v3, Section7, Theorem7.1 and Remark7.15. The exact saved source
is bound in source_entry.
The theorem's working class is explicitly the states

    C^* (|0><0|^(m-t) tensor sigma_t) C,                       (1)

with C Clifford and sigma_t any mixed t-qubit state. Section7.1 supplies the
known Clifford C as well as, optionally, tomography of sigma_t. The latter is
not needed below. The claimed generic algorithm is quasipolynomial in inverse
error. Remark7.15 explicitly restores

    poly(m,2^t,1/e,log(1/delta))                              (2)

in the near-realizable regime 1/f <= 1+c e, with c a fixed constant, where f
is a warranted lower fidelity to (1) and e is the requested additive fidelity
loss. The ordinary method receives precisely the same independent actual
Choi copies and known Clifford/product measurements as the direct route.

There is a real convention error in source Definition4.10: invariance under
conjugation by a Pauli is called isotropic for arbitrary mixed states. The
maximally mixed state is a counterexample to that assertion. We DO NOT import
that weak-invariance definition or its false isotropy consequence. Throughout
this note the target class is exactly (1), equivalently support in the chosen
sign sector of an isotropic rank m-t Pauli subgroup. The constructive Section7
proof admits that strong-class restriction, as detailed in Section2. The
explicit class, projector output and constructive argument carry the port;
the false general weak-symmetry assertion does not.
